notes.title: Graphics update!
notes.content: This update contains some graphical changes, including a more fleshed out stadium with higher bleachers and country flags, some props in the infield, and some shading adjustments to various objects.

notes.title: Bug fixes/optimizations
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue causing frames and animations to sometimes stutter on higher Hz monitors. NOTE: This update will cause the physics to be very slightly different, but much smoother.
- Fixed a issue where the 60m button was finicky and hard to activate.
- Added a tip for saving ghosts when players load the leaderboard for the first time.

notes.title: Update 12/28/20
notes.content:
- Leaderboard update: Combined Total and Individual Total show the fastest combined player and fastest combined athlete respectively. Also fixed some visual bugs for the leaderboard.
- Splits: you will now be shown how fast you were over the first half of the race for the 200m and 400m!
- Added 3 new stadium themes and 3 music tracks

notes.title: UI and graphical improvements
notes.content:
- made user interface more streamlined
- graphical enhancements, visual improvements for players on monitors that support more than 60Hz

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed bug making you unable to download some ghosts
- Setup screen buttons are now listed in order of time

notes.title: Leaderboard bug fixes
notes.content:
- Disabled both "Combined" leaderboard features for now, as they appear bugged
- Fixed UI issues with loading the leaderboard
- Added loading animation
